title: Viking Grace 替代燃料渡輪
summary: 以Viking Grace替代燃料客貨渡輪作例，分開貨運、旅館服務與燃料熱管理，辨識同時改善多種指標時的邊界差異。 各單元為獨立縮尺練習，串接的是驗證流程，不是同一實船的校準數位分身。
summaryEn: Use Viking Grace to separate freight, hotel services and fuel thermal management in an alternative-fuel ferry, identifying boundaries when several performance indicators change. Units are independent scaled exercises connected by a verification workflow, not a calibrated digital twin of one vessel.
scope: 依公開原理編寫的原創船舶海洋教學。數值均為明示假設，不是同名船舶的實測規格、法規認證或實船操作參數。以虛構資料、教學模型與常壓桌面練習學習，排除武器、戰術與載人下潛操作。
scopeEn: Original marine teaching based on public principles. All numbers are explicit assumptions, not measured named-vessel specifications, certification criteria or real-ship operating parameters. Learning uses synthetic data, teaching models and unpressurized desktop exercises, excluding weapons, tactics and crewed diving operations.

steps.title: 列客運和貨運不同功能單位：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: List distinct passenger and freight functional units: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 列客運和貨運不同功能單位 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of List distinct passenger and freight functional units and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 列客運和貨運不同功能單位：噸公里是載重乘距離，可比較同一服務量的能源需求；空載回程會改變整個任務帳。 本步以「載運功能單位與效率」對應案例介面，先標記輸入、輸出與未計入項目。
steps.instructionEn: List distinct passenger and freight functional units: Tonne-kilometres are payload times distance and compare energy for equal service; empty return legs change the mission ledger. Use Transport functional units and efficiency to describe the case interface, marking input, output and omitted terms first.
steps.observation: 各單元數值是獨立練習，不能合併成同一實船的質量或能源帳。本單元獨立的原創縮尺教學資料，不是Viking Grace 替代燃料渡輪實際規格：貨物m=1000 t、距離d=500 km。式 Wtransport=md，基準結果 500000 t·km。條件：單程貨重距離指標，不是機械做功，也未含空載和港口能耗。
steps.observationEn: Numbers in different units are independent exercises and cannot be combined into one vessel mass or energy ledger. Independent original scaled data for this unit, not actual specifications of Viking Grace alternative-fuel ferry: Cargo m=1000 t, distance d=500 km. Formula Wtransport=md gives 500000 t·km. Conditions: One-way payload-distance indicator, not mechanical work; empty legs and port energy excluded.
steps.failure: 只用最大載重而非實際載重會美化每噸公里指標；需核對裝載率。 若案例資料尚缺，先標為未驗證，不能用同名船舶的外觀照片填補數值。
steps.failureEn: Using maximum rather than actual payload artificially improves per-tonne-kilometre metrics; inspect utilization. Mark missing case data as unverified rather than filling values from a photograph of the named vessel.
steps.check: 分別填裝載與空載航段的燃料和距離，使用同一邊界比較不同船型。 本案例另須檢查「列客運和貨運不同功能單位」與前一步資料是否使用同一時間、單位與系統邊界。
steps.checkEn: Log fuel and distance for loaded and empty legs separately and compare vessels under a common boundary. Also check that List distinct passenger and freight functional units and the preceding step share time, units and system boundaries.

knowledge.title: 驗證與操作練習
knowledge.text: 本單元任務：列客運和貨運不同功能單位。在客貨渡輪分區、燃料熱量與服務需求圖完成資料或紙面模型練習。只增加貨物質量10%，保持距離，算服務量；不得假設能耗必不變。 算式區的基準值為500000，改變後為550000 t·km。先預測方向，再計算、記錄原式與新式，最後寫下仍需量測的資料。
knowledge.textEn: Unit task: List distinct passenger and freight functional units. Complete a data or paper-model exercise at the RoPax zones, fuel-heat and service-demand diagrams. Increase payload alone by 10%, retain distance and calculate service without assuming unchanged energy. Baseline 500000 changes to 550000 t·km. Predict direction, calculate, retain both expressions and record the measurement still needed.

knowledge.title: 檢查車輛甲板的重心假設
knowledge.text: 把角度5直接代入rad公式會嚴重高估；先查角度單位，再查GM來源。 若案例資料尚缺，先標為未驗證，不能用同名船舶的外觀照片填補數值。
knowledge.textEn: Entering 5 degrees as 5 radians severely overestimates moment; check angular units and then the GM source. Mark missing case data as unverified rather than filling values from a photograph of the named vessel.

knowledge.title: 驗證與操作練習
knowledge.text: 本單元任務：檢查車輛甲板的重心假設。在客貨渡輪分區、燃料熱量與服務需求圖完成資料或紙面模型練習。只增加排水質量10%，保持假設GM與角度固定；另說明實船GM可能也會改變。 算式區的基準值為313.92，改變後為345.312 kN·m。先預測方向，再計算、記錄原式與新式，最後寫下仍需量測的資料。
knowledge.textEn: Unit task: Check vehicle-deck center assumptions. Complete a data or paper-model exercise at the RoPax zones, fuel-heat and service-demand diagrams. Increase mass alone by 10% at fixed assumed GM and angle, then explain that real-vessel GM may also change. Baseline 313.92 changes to 345.312 kN·m. Predict direction, calculate, retain both expressions and record the measurement still needed.

quiz.question: 哪一項正確描述本步應診斷的失效原因？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement correctly describes the failure to diagnose?
options: 看到結果符合預期就可省略條件、單位與原始資料。
初始GM為正就代表任何傾角都不會翻覆。
把角度5直接代入rad公式會嚴重高估；先查角度單位，再查GM來源。
optionsEn: An expected result allows conditions, units and raw data to be omitted.
Positive initial GM means capsizing is impossible at every heel angle.
Entering 5 degrees as 5 radians severely overestimates moment; check angular units and then the GM source.
quiz.explanation: 把角度5直接代入rad公式會嚴重高估；先查角度單位，再查GM來源。 將橫搖角由度轉rad，再用同一假設比較回復力矩；以紙面重心上移情境討論GM下降。 本案例另須檢查「檢查車輛甲板的重心假設」與前一步資料是否使用同一時間、單位與系統邊界。
quiz.explanationEn: Entering 5 degrees as 5 radians severely overestimates moment; check angular units and then the GM source. Convert roll angle from degrees to radians and compare restoring moment under fixed assumptions; discuss lower GM when a paper-model center of gravity rises. Also check that Check vehicle-deck center assumptions and the preceding step share time, units and system boundaries.
